asr.full_text: Adding funds to your Miratrading International Pool Account Click on the Wallet section on the left. A roll-down will appear. Click on Add funds. The payment information screen will appear. You can either scan the QR code or carefully copy the Bitcoin address to your wallet. Make the payment by sending the Bitcoin. Remember some wallets require you to verify the payment via email Fill in the details The exact amount of Bitcoin you've sent Enter the blockchain transaction ID or TX ID Upload the proof of payment screenshot then click submit Once the admin has confirmed your Bitcoin transfer it will appear in your trading account. In this case your dashboard will confirm that you are a paid member. Each day you will recieve a statement, via email, telling you the results of the trades. You can also log in to your backup office to see these results and your statements . Click on the view option to see your daily statement. That is your account and how to see results from daily trading. Should you wish to refer your friends, you can send them your registration link or you can help them register by clicking on the downline registration link. For more information, please contact the person who sent you this video.

textual.context: Instructional/promotional context is supported by the title, description, and step-by-step account-funding narration; the records do not independently establish the destination, operator, or outcome.
textual.potential_relevance: The stated opportunity to make or earn bitcoin is presented alongside a requested Bitcoin transfer and submission of a transaction ID and payment screenshot, with account credit contingent on admin confirmation.
textual.limitations: These records do not establish that the wallet address belongs to a particular entity, that any transfer occurred, that trading results or earnings were obtained, or that the referenced website was accessed or verified.

visual.observation: The video shows an MTI/Mirror Trading International back-office payment form for a named account with a Bitcoin QR code and wallet-address selector, fields for the Bitcoin amount sent and transaction ID, an upload control for proof of payment, and a Submit button. A later sampled dashboard displays the account as "Paid Member" and shows a Trading Pool Balance of BTC 0.013 / USD 103.45.
visual.context: Visible as a screen-recorded walkthrough titled "Adding funds to your MTI Pool Account"; whether it is promotional, instructional, or another context is unclear from the sampled frames.
visual.potential_relevance: The displayed flow links a requested Bitcoin payment, transaction identifier, and payment proof to an account described as a paid member with a displayed trading-pool balance.
visual.limitations: The samples do not establish that a transfer was made, that the shown account status or balance resulted from the submitted form, who controls the displayed wallet, or any actual outcome.

visual.observation: A Trading Bonus Report lists multiple entries with remarks such as "Trading Result" and a Status of "Paid"; the dashboard also displays a Trading Pool Balance. Separately, the video shows a sign-up form with Sponsor Information and "Auto Placement," and fields requesting a username, password, first and last name, email address, mobile number, and country. The closing screen says to contact the person who referred you.
visual.context: The frames show account-report and registration interfaces in the same screen-recorded sequence; the relationship between a referral, registration, funding, and reported bonuses is not fully visible.
visual.potential_relevance: The observed materials pair reported paid trading-bonus entries with a sponsored/referral registration path that requests contact and account information and directs viewers to a referrer.
visual.limitations: The samples do not show the terms for bonuses, whether referral or registration is required to receive them, whether any participant was paid, or the purpose and handling of submitted information.

visual_context_notes.observation: The video is presented as a walkthrough for adding funds to an "MTI Pool Account," and the interfaces use Mirror Trading International branding.
The back-office dashboard visibly includes referral-related labels such as Direct Referrals, Left Team, Right Team, Referral Link, and Downline Registration.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it presents funding an MTI account as a way to earn Bitcoin and directs viewers to send Bitcoin to a payment destination, submit transaction details, and upload proof of payment. Paid-member and trading-bonus displays, registration, and referral direction reinforce this recruitment and payment pathway. the available video evidence does not establish who controls the wallet or whether transfers or displayed results were realized.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The video links funding a pool account with Bitcoin to making Bitcoin through a trading account, and presents daily trade results and a displayed trading-bonus report. It does not establish a fixed or guaranteed return.
